title: Signing commands: register, add-key, retire-key, endorse, approve, revoke
description: Write records and sign via ssh-keygen -Y sign (agent or key file); never touch private keys, never push. register builds person file from a pubkey; add-key/retire-key edit and re-sign with all current keys; endorse/approve/revoke write the records with correct namespaces.
acceptance_criteria: Each command's output passes 'git vouch check' in a fixture registry; add-key without an existing key's signature fails check; commands never prompt.
notes: Per DESIGN.md 2026-10-22: endorse writes subjectEmails (D2); 'register [--from FILE]' completes a git-vouch-migrate draft keeping migratedFrom; register/add-key --attestation BLOBFILE --challenge FILE embed {blob, challenge}; person-file signing needs any one key current in the previous version (D11).
